fields.name: magic

fields.name: header_check

fields.name: header_reserved
fields.meaning: Inside the checked header but never copied to or from memory; always zero

fields.name: header_flags
fields.meaning: Shared progress flags kept outside the game slots (loaded at power-on before the main menu). Bit 7 of the second byte is set once the first island starts. The same 6 bytes plus the next 3 memory bytes are also mirrored into the console internal memory record. Set/cleared/tested through the flag routines 5000:63ed/6416/63c2 with numbers mapped by 5000:643d
fields.evidence: code: copy 4000:1534 (RAM 0x0A91 -> SRAM) / 4000:1506 (SRAM -> RAM 0x0A91); bootreads 4000:151f; diff island-start; flag bitop family 5000:637a-643d

fields.name: header_unused

fields.evidence: code: no copy covers 0x38-0x91; diff zero

fields.name: header_unlocks
fields.meaning: Four flag bytes summarising unlock/collection state: built bit by bit (0x80,0x40,...) from game flag queries numbered 0x10 and up, then saved with the header. Zero in all runs; compared against the working copy at 6000:5eb1
fields.evidence: code: 6000:5830 builds RAM 0x0D78-0x0D7B, 6000:5a39 stages to 0x0D7C and saves header (4000:1534); load 4000:1506; diff zero

fields.name: slot0.check
fields.meaning: Slot 0 = Story mode island-start copy: written when an island begins (first turn). Loaded when the player answers YES to "restart from the beginning of the saved island". Check word: bitwise NOT of the 16-bit sum of the next 0x50C bytes. An empty slot stores the correct value plus 1 so it always fails the check
fields.evidence: code: write 4000:033a, verify 4000:02ce (CX=0x50E-2); init 4000:022a adds 1 (INC); recomputed: all written slots match, empty = 0000

fields.name: slot0.game_mode
fields.meaning: Game mode the slot belongs to (RAM 0x06B0: 0 Story, 1 second mode, 2 never saves). The save routine picks the slot as 0 or 1 + this value. Set by the mode entry routines 5000:069b/06b2/06c4
fields.evidence: code: 5000:2a87 (slot = AL ? AL+[06B0] : 0; skip if [06B0]=2); 5000:6110; mode entries; diff 0 in all runs

fields.name: slot0.island_index
fields.meaning: Story island/stage number (RAM 0x06B1): reset to 0 by the Story/mode-2 entries and used to index the per-island flag base table at 5000:6472

fields.name: slot0.sub_state
